baseline_selection: Verify the published signed release and native archive, actual commit, Cargo, driver, sysroot, BOLT and release build recipe first. A changed pin requires a new source registration before measurement.
Run the original five-visit CTFE regression and the normal edited-uv native checks on the signed stock compiler.
If the signed build passes the native checks, use it as the published baseline, with the identical signed Cargo on both arms.

If the specific cache-identity regression reproduces, preserve its full raw failure, run the real #318 port on both compiler sources with the same -23 release recipe and signed Cargo, and label the matched comparison corrected -23. Any other failure remains unscored.
Reserve and verify the final combined incremental namespace before producing any child binary; compare role-specific cold/warm, migration and typed rmeta results using the actual binaries.

canonical_native_regression.workload: all five actual linked/public-hash visits in rdr-public-hash-ctfe-literal-identity

cohort.authentic: Validate the new signed Cargo actual -23 graph, all eight source files, true A/index first B, typed 39-product warm-vs-independent-cold and prior B/no-op native outputs; refuse unexpected dirty jobs or changes in companion correctness.
cohort.visits: Unwrapped blocking Cargo first-B. Restore each exact pristine cold-A state separately for whole-tree PMU and actual per-rustc PMU.

excludes_unqualified_change: e4ed and all speculative followups are outside the three-PR residual stack.
logical_question: How much of the independently replicated uv #22958 ordinary cargo check speedup remains over the actual Ohm -23 line?

report.instructions: Report both per-rustc retired counts and their sum from hardware separately. For a named 20% cut require 5*child <= 4*parent in all eight pairs and both hold medians.
report.other: Preserve and report a miss and any regression. Report corrected-release and signed-release evidence separately.
report.wall: All eight paired bare clocks, per-hold median, full median ratio. An eight-of-eight result strictly over 2x must repeat on a separately enrolled independent machine before a twofold claim.

status: Prospective source registration; requires actual Ohm -23 binaries and all physical gates
